$comment: PERMANENT abbrev registry for the Driftwood freight-brokerage vertical (Phase 5). Abbrevs are 3-letter lowercase, collision-checked, and NEVER recycled or changed once assigned. The BUILT substrate reads ONE global registry (samen_core/priv/abbrev_registry.json via :code.priv_dir(:samen_core)); the scope-DEFAULT abbrevs (cmp/per/… for CRM, bcu/… for Billing, stk/… for Support) are already owned by the demo mount, so Driftwood mounts every scope with FRESH f-prefixed abbrevs to avoid the global-registry collision: CRM fcm/fpr/fpp/fop/fac/fat, Billing fbc/fbs/fbp/fbr/fbi/fby/fbu/fbe, Support fsk/fsc/fsm/fsa/fsl/fsn/fss. The vertical Freight resources take drv/stl/dsp/dak. This file mirrors those reserved rows for Driftwood bookkeeping; the global registry is the authoritative gate.
